# BizNest USA

> BizNest USA is the nationwide American business directory, verified professional network, and job platform connecting consumers, businesses, and employers across all 50 US states.

## Overview
BizNest USA offers comprehensive discovery and verified listings for American local businesses, licensed trade and creative professionals, and verified employment opportunities.

## Main Directories
- [Business Directory](https://www.biznestusa.com/search/): Search and discover verified businesses across 16 core industries.
- [Categories](https://www.biznestusa.com/categories/): Complete directory categorization covering trades, medical, legal, tech, and retail.
- [US States & Metros](https://www.biznestusa.com/cities/): Localized directory hubs for all 50 US states and major metropolitan areas.
- [Professional Directory](https://www.biznestusa.com/professionals/): Verified portfolios and contact profiles for independent specialists and contractors.
- [Jobs Marketplace](https://www.biznestusa.com/jobs/): Searchable career vacancies with salary, remote/on-site filters, and employer profiles.

## Core Workflows
- [List Your Business](https://www.biznestusa.com/add-business/): Register and publish your company listing.
- [Create Professional Profile](https://www.biznestusa.com/add-professional/): Create an individual professional portfolio.
- [Post a Job](https://www.biznestusa.com/post-job/): Post hiring requirements and reach qualified candidates.

## Platform Governance & Trust
- [About Us](https://www.biznestusa.com/about/): Mission, executive leadership, and platform standards.
- [Verification Policy](https://www.biznestusa.com/verification-policy/): Rigorous vetting process for US business and professional authenticity.
- [Editorial Policy](https://www.biznestusa.com/editorial-policy/): Guidelines governing reviews, updates, and content integrity.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.biznestusa.com/terms/): User and merchant terms of service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.biznestusa.com/privacy/): Comprehensive data privacy and CCPA/GDPR compliance.

## Optional
- [Full LLM Specification](https://www.biznestusa.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed directory taxonomy, API structures, and full schema guide.
